purpose: Route work by demonstrated capability, not agent title or self-claim.

levels.principal: 95+ with cross-agent teaching and no unresolved critical incident

routing_rule: A task may be assigned only when the agent has passed the relevant domain and consequence skill gates. High-risk work requires both domain score and risk-control score.
promotion_rule: Minimum five relevant eval cases, at least two real-world proof events, no unresolved critical error and seven-day post-promotion monitoring.
demotion_rule: Critical unsupported claim, unsafe action, stock/payment/data corruption, repeated incomplete work or regression breach triggers immediate traffic reduction or quarantine.
decay_rule: Skills that depend on current tools, markets, policies or integrations lose freshness confidence after 30 days without verified use or re-evaluation.

agents.next_gate: move one product from public demo to paid proof
pass capacity, putaway, box occupancy and exception cases
move one verified lead through sent, reply, quote and payable state
run first champion-challenger suite and publish verdict

important_note: Seed scores are placeholders for routing safety and are not evidence of actual capability. They must be replaced by evaluation results.
